metadata.description: Skills for coding agents working on Godot 4 games: GDScript, shaders, Blender assets and game videos, from the Godot Agent Harness project.

plugins.name: gdscript
plugins.description: Godot 4 GDScript design and review: architecture (Node vs Resource vs RefCounted, scenes, SOLID), how systems talk (signals, EventBus, autoloads, init order), gameplay patterns (state machines, components, pools, commands), data-driven content and saves, and a code review checklist.

plugins.name: shaders
plugins.description: Non-trivial Godot 4.6+ shaders: coordinate spaces, custom light(), color spaces, normal maps, procedural shapes, vertex effects, post-processing, ray marching. Engine facts compile-checked on 4.6, 4.7 and 4.8.

plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Blender 5 for Godot games: build and check 3D assets with headless Python, then export them to Godot 4 with the right scale, axes, collisions, materials and animations. Checked on Blender 5.2 and Godot 4.7.

plugins.name: godot-video
plugins.description: Make videos from a Godot 4 game using real footage: repeatable Movie Maker capture, trailers, game design document explainers and code-to-result development films. Needs only Godot and ffmpeg.

plugins.name: godot-testing
plugins.description: Check a Godot 4 game by running it: repeatable screenshot tests with a diff of what changed, and before and after performance comparisons of frame, GPU and script time, draw calls, nodes and memory.

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Godot 4.7 engine skills (GDScript, nodes, physics, shaders, export, C#). From awesome-gamedev-agent-skills (Apache 2.0), installed from its repo.

plugins.name: disciplines
plugins.description: Cross-engine concepts: visual assets, AI, procedural gen, dialogue, saves, audio, shaders, physics, level design, and input. From awesome-gamedev-agent-skills (Apache 2.0), installed from its repo.

plugins.name: genres
plugins.description: Compositional genre templates: platformer, roguelike, RPG, FPS, tower defense, card, visual novel, survival, puzzle. From awesome-gamedev-agent-skills (Apache 2.0), installed from its repo.

plugins.name: workflows
plugins.description: Process and shipping skills: game jam, fast prototyping, Steam, itch.io. From awesome-gamedev-agent-skills (Apache 2.0), installed from its repo.
